content.content:
Applied by a reviewer reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs.

Read the dependent's recorded commitment against each recorded prerequisite in turn, one clause per prerequisite, and fail on any element of the dependent that contradicts the prerequisite the clause names.

(1) licence against mwwxxzyk — no element of the dependent contradicts mwwxxzyk; fail, naming the element, if the dependent forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome mwwxxzyk fixes, or narrows mwwxxzyk by excepting a case it covers.

(2) licence against rusopkql — no element of the dependent contradicts rusopkql; same failure and same naming.

(3) licence against kwxutvpw — no element of the dependent contradicts kwxutvpw; same failure and same naming.

(4) no recorded subject — a placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment in the dependent, or in a prerequisite a clause is read against, leaves the licence check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder.

The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular clause of a prerequisite; which element is at issue is a finding named in the check's output, never in this criterion. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent, so rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides leaves the criterion intact, and it invents no rule the prerequisites do not state.
content.rationale:
All four endpoints are commitments in words held inline: mwwxxzyk, rusopkql and kwxutvpw are inline prose decisions and kpkstnps is an inline prose decision, so every edge here sits on the natural layer at both ends. The pairs therefore cover the matrix's natural-to-natural cell, evals/natural-to-natural.md, whose check — no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite, the contradicting element named only in the check's output — is copied as the criterion and applied once per prerequisite. Nothing in the matrix has to be extended for this evaluation.

The three uses the clauses gate, each stated as why the question is asked of this dependent rather than what the answer is. The dependent relies on mwwxxzyk for the link presentation of listed relationship ids: it carves an appearance case out of that presentation, so the licence question is whether the carve contradicted the rule that a listed id reads as a visible link — and it must stay a carve, not a re-decision of which entries are links. It relies on rusopkql for the inert condition of an id that names no node: rusopkql settles that such an entry stays listed and that activating it changes nothing, and its text keeps the entry free of any mark of its own, so the licence question is whether the dependent's cue abstention stayed an abstention — stated as a cue the entry does not take, not as a claim that the node is missing — and whether it left rusopkql's listing and inertness, and the absence of a mark, in force. It relies on kwxutvpw for the activation the cues promise: kwxutvpw makes a listed id an activatable entry driven by a pointer click and by Enter or Space while focused, so the licence question is whether withholding the pointer and the focus cue from an id that names no node contradicts the activation kwxutvpw fixes for listed ids, instead of being, as intended, the exact case kwxutvpw left unstated.

Nothing more than non-violation is checked, and no clause probes behaviour. The endpoints are words: a prose prerequisite states no observable, so demanding one would exceed the licence the edge gives, and a dependent in words is sound exactly when it contradicts none of its prerequisites — whether the cues are in fact absent, and whether the surface behaves as the words say, are observable only of the code-layer artifact and are gated where the viewer becomes one, not from a node pair that decides no behaviour. Because the criterion names no element in advance, it survives rewording of the dependent; and because it asserts nothing the prerequisites do not, it is decidable against the recorded graph alone.
